Intro: Greetings, chef. There was an execution today.
Our Lady's plans for the country continue to proceed well, but Verehn isn't falling in line as much as she'd like, I suppose?
She had a plan in mind—a vision for Verehn in five years. Free of Spoilage, free of dissent. But our doctor is wandering the city, and she has made no effort to find him. And the rebels….
She's been leveraging the Spoilage crisis, but foreign sympathy cannot last forever. And I ask myself if Svetka had any sympathy at all.
After the Spoiled lose their purpose, I ask myself what she will do. I believe Nadezdha has come to a conclusion, already.
This country cannot handle any sort of conflict, any war. Not now. I don't know what to do.
